meta.name: CCNL per i dipendenti da agenti immobiliari professionali e mandatari a titolo oneroso
signatories: FIAIP — Federazione Italiana Agenti Immobiliari Professionali

notes.text: Salary model: CONGLOBATED. Art. 158 explicitly lists the composition: paga base nazionale conglobata comprising paga base + contingenza ex art. 98 CCNL 11/6/97 + EDR accordo interconfederale 21/07/92 + elemento economico di 2° livello ex art. 95 CCNL 11/6/97. Art. 162 title: 'Paga base nazionale conglobata'. Modelled as base_salary (TimeSeries per level) with fixed_allowances: [] for all levels.

CatA/CatB cross-verification: Art. 164 defines CatA = 90% of level II and CatB = 90% of level III for agencies ≤15 employees with commission-based pay. Cross-check at 01/05/2025: 0.9×2156.50=1940.85 (CatA matches), 0.9×1925.95=1733.355≈1733.36 (CatB matches). This independently confirms all four tranche values for levels II and III.

hourly_divisor: 168 — confirmed from Art. 161 explicit text ('La quota oraria della retribuzione, si ottiene dividendo l'importo mensile per 168'). Also consistent with Art. 67 (hourly divisor = 168) and Art. 103 (standard weekly hours = 40).

additional_months: 14 — Art. 168 (tredicesima, December) and Art. 169 (quattordicesima, 1 July) both explicit in CCNL. Art. 7 ter also references tredicesima and quattordicesima as separate institutes.
Seniority: 10 scatti triennali (cadence_months=36, maximum_count=10). Amounts from Art. 157 CCNL: Q=33.05, I=30.99, II=28.41, III=25.31, IV=23.24, V=22.21, VI=21.17 EUR.

Tranche arithmetic verification: Art. 163 prints four tables. Q: 2500.20+104.63=2604.83, +59.79=2664.62, +59.79=2724.41, +74.73=2799.14. Level IV: 1672.68+70.00=1742.68, +40.00=1782.68, +40.00=1822.68, +50.00=1872.68. Both reconcile exactly. Tabelle retributive values treated as authoritative.

Apprenticeship: apprendistato professionalizzante, under-classification model (Art. 40, 46, 48 CCNL 19/05/2025). Q and I excluded per Art. 46. Levels II-V eligible, all 36 months per Art. 48. Art. 40: first half 2 levels below, second half 1 level below. Special rule for dest=V: 1 level below throughout (Art. 40 'Per l'apprendistato al 5° livello l'inquadramento è di 1 livello inferiore per tutto il periodo formativo'). Source: signed CCNL 19/05/2025, Art. 40, 46, 48.

tax_sector: terziario. Signatories include FILCAMS-CGIL, FISASCAT-CISL and UILTUCS-UIL — the three national federations that represent the commerce/services sector and sign terziario contracts. 2026-terziario.json exists; no new TaxSector needed.

first valid_from is 2025-05-01 (decorrenza del rinnovo per le tabelle retributive). agreement_date 2025-05-19 is the signature date; these differ per precedent (IC91: agreement_date 2023-02-28, first tranche 2021-01-01). April 2025 table from Art. 162 is the previgente table — not modelled as a period.

SIMPLIFICATION: CatA and CatB (Art. 164) not modelled as levels. These are special mixed-salary categories for agencies with ≤15 employees where workers receive commission income, modelled at 90% of level II and III respectively with mandatory commission minimum and 2% guarantee. Conditional on employer size and pay structure; not standard classification levels.

SPECIALIST APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 55, PDF p. 46): the apprendistato professionalizzante 'specialistico' for the mediazione immobiliare duties 'ha durata pari a 2 (due) anni con assunzione al 5° livello iniziale e conclusione al 3° livello'. Art. 40 (p. 41) sets the pay of every apprentice at '2 livelli inferiori [...] per la prima metà' and '1 livello inferiore [...] per la seconda metà': track III-mediazione-specialistico-24m pays V for months 0-11 and IV for months 12-23. Art. 55 states no middle level of its own; Art. 40 does not exempt it and its first half matches the hiring level V. The caller selects the track (Apprentice.track): a level III apprentice now needs it, between the 36-month Art. 48 track and this one. Eligibility (duties that require the CCIAA exam) is the caller's.

Source provenance: values extracted from signed CCNL 19/05/2025 PDF distributed by FIAIP/EBNAIP. The direct PDF download URL was not recorded; the homepage https://www.ebnaip.it/ was used as the source anchor. All values verified page-by-page against the original document.

Art. 15 (p. 26): Fon.Te., employer 1.55% and worker minimum 0.55% of the TFR base, the 0.05 quota associativa included in each (parameters.employer_funds FONTE); the TFR share, 50% or 100%, is the worker's choice. The una tantum of 15.50 EUR at enrolment is not paid by the engine.

LEAVE (CCNL 2025, EBNAIP): ferie 26 working days on a week counted as six (Art. 122, p. 79), twelfths per month of service at termination (Art. 125); 56 hours of reduction and 32 of ex festività a year on both the 5- and 6-day week, a twelfth per whole month of service (Art. 105, pp. 70-71); not taken within the year paid with the December pay or, by agreement, taken by 30 June and the rest paid with the June pay (EmployerProfile.permit_carryover); daily quota 1/26 and hourly 1/168 (Artt. 160-161, p. 96), used for the leave left at termination.

reviews.scope: The paga base nazionale conglobata of the seven levels against the signed ipotesi of 19 May 2025 and the final text of the CCNL 2025 (Ebnaip).
findings: Tabelle retributive of the signed ipotesi (p. 7, scan checked on the page image): the 28 minimi from 1/5/2025 to 1/5/2027 match the file and move from assumed to verified. The final text of the CCNL (Ebnaip copy, art. 162-163, PDF pp. 96-97) prints the same base at April 2025, increments and final amounts.
The ruleset names the signed ipotesi published by FIAIP, the employer signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.

reviews.scope: The indennità di funzione of the quadri, Art. 162 note (*) (p. 97).
findings: Art. 162 note (*) (p. 97): 250.00 a month for 12 months to the quadri responsible for operational or local units: levels[Q].fixed_allowances[IND_FUNZIONE], role responsabile_unita, months_per_year 12.

Art. 163 (pp. 97-98): two installments of the table (Q 149.47 ... IV 100.00 ... VI 87.28) from 1 September 2025 and 1 May 2026, full for a hire before 1 January 2024, by the months worked to 1 May 2025 for a hire from 1 January 2024: parameters.una_tantum[UT_2025].

reviews.scope: The notice clause (Art. 176 (table); art. 177 (indemnity); art. 178 (TFR); art. 181 (resignations), p. 102-104).
findings: Notice bands by level and service checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: the CCNL Agenti immobiliari 2025 (apprenticeship and seniority articles).
findings: The apprentice is classified one level below with 'lo stesso trattamento normativo'; 'Per l'anzianità di servizio maturata presso lo stesso datore di lavoro, il personale ha diritto a dieci scatti triennali': the increments of the level the apprentice is paid at.

reviews.scope: Open limitations claimed to be no longer gaps: one session read the clauses and the data, a second independent session checked the claim.
findings: quadri_function_allowance: The agreement's Q fixed_allowances already contains IND_FUNZIONE at EUR 250.00/month from 2025-05-01, restricted to role responsabile_unita and months_per_year=12. compensation/element/rules.py gates on the worker's roles; element/types.py excludes 12-month allowances from extra-

reviews.scope: EBNAIP contributions of art. 11 of the 2025 text, read on the text layer (analysis by a separate model session).
findings: Added the QSC (1.60% employer, 0.30% worker of the monthly pay on 14 months; 2.40% E.A.R. to the worker when the employer does not pay, on 14 months, in the TFR) and the employer's flat quota of 12 EUR on twelve months.

reviews.scope: Art. 15 of the CCNL FIAIP 2025 (PDF p. 26, text layer).
findings: Fon.Te.: employer 1.55% and worker 0.55% of the TFR base, the 0.05 quota associativa included (the old note added it on top); TFR 50% or 100% at the worker's choice; una tantum 15.50 EUR at enrolment.

reviews.scope: Art. 163, una tantum table and hire-date clause, PDF pp. 97-98.
findings: Verified both installments for all seven levels against the final PDF, including the 1 January 2024 full-payment cutoff and proportional payment for later hires through 1 May 2025. Removed an obsolete exclusion note.

reviews.scope: Artt. 40 and 55, apprentice pay steps and the specialist track, PDF pp. 41 and 46.
findings: Read both pages on the page image: Art. 55 gives 24 months from level V to level III; Art. 40 gives two levels below for the first half and one below for the second to the apprentices of the CCNL, with no exception for Art. 55. Added the 24-month track and closed the specialist_apprenticeship_track limitation.

reviews.scope: Artt. 105, 122, 125, 160 and 161 of the CCNL 2025 (ferie, permits, deadline, quotas).
findings: The file had no leave rules: added the ferie, the 32 + 56 hours of permits with their whole-month accrual, the December/June deadline and the termination quotas.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

Art. 169 of the CCNL Agenti immobiliari FIAIP pays the quattordicesima on 1 July, as recorded in the coverage notes of this file; the clause is not located in a source the bundle holds (the ruleset source is unavailable).
